relations: The couple stands face-to-face with hands clasped, the woman keeping one leg bent and raised.
A slow zoom gradually enlarges the scene, shifting the couple and the distant rock closer.
The flaring sun remains behind the couple, its glow drawing toward the gap between their heads.
Breaking waves continuously roll across the background while elongated reflections persist on the wet shore.
caption: The video captures a backlit silhouette of a couple standing face-to-face on wet sand, hands joined, with the low sun flaring behind them and a horizontal streak cutting the sky. Breaking surf rolls across the background, and a dark rock sits on the right horizon while their reflections stretch down the glistening shore. The woman's bent leg, with its foot lifted clear of the ground, remains bent and raised. Over time, both figures stand upright, their mutual facing and clasped hands unchanged. A slow, slight enlargement of the scene shifts the couple and the rock marginally closer, drawing the sun toward the gap between their heads. The foreground reflection stays elongated beneath the standing figures. The waves keep breaking and receding in the background.
